project_type: Next.js 16.4.3 App Router design-system library (El-Kema e-learning platform). React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4 (CSS-first), shadcn/ui new-york, cva, next-intl (Arabic default/RTL + English), next-themes class dark mode.
build_system: npm + Next.js (turbopack). Tailwind v4 is CSS-first: tokens are CSS variables in src/app/globals.css mapped via an @theme inline block — NOT a tailwind.config file. Windows/PowerShell: chain commands with ';' not '&&'.
test_framework: vitest 3 + @testing-library/react + jsdom. Tests are colocated as *.test.tsx next to components. Render inside <NextIntlClientProvider locale="en" messages={en.json}>.
test_command: npm run test  (scoped: npx vitest run src/components/organisms)
verification_instructions: From repo root, all must pass at ZERO errors, in order: 1) npm run typegen  2) npm run typecheck  3) npm run lint  4) npm run test (existing 79 tests stay green + new tests pass)  5) npm run build. Fix every failure before marking done. Clean up temp files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: next typegen generates route types (.next/types). Run `npm run typegen` before `npm run typecheck`. No other checked-in generated files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell — use ';' to chain, never '&&'. Do NOT add any dependency (especially no charting lib) — charts are custom SVG/flex from token colors. Do NOT alter the core palette or font in globals.css (additive utility classes only). Do NOT adopt organisms into real app pages (that is a later stage) — build the library + tests only.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: this Next.js version has breaking changes — consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing Next-specific code. Keep messages/ar.json and messages/en.json in SYNC (messages-parity.test.ts asserts identical organisms key sets). Barrel-export every new organism from src/components/organisms/index.ts. Compose existing atoms/molecules/icons — never duplicate their styling.
key_patterns: Organism pattern (see src/components/organisms/plans-card.tsx and leaderboard.tsx): React.forwardRef, data-slot + data-state attributes, aria-labelledby with React.useId(), cva variants exported alongside the component (e.g. `export { PlansCard, plansCardVariants }`), useTranslations("organisms") for fallback copy with all content prop-driven. Styling uses cn(@/lib/utils/cn) + Tailwind token utilities (bg-primary, text-secondary, text-body, shadow-card, rounded-lg/rounded-card-xl, border-border). RTL/LTR via LOGICAL properties only: ps/pe, start/end, text-start/text-end — never left/right. Typography applied with inline arbitrary utilities today (text-[28px] leading-10 font-bold); Paragraph md 18/28 and H4 Semibold 600 are NOT yet reusable classes (add additive component classes text-paragraph-md and text-h4-semibold in globals.css @layer components). Status colors map to existing tokens: secondary/#14b8a6 + secondary-light/#ccfbf1, destructive(error)/#ef4444 + destructive-light-strong/#fee2e2, warning/#df900a + warning-light/#fef3c7, muted/#a1a1aa, accent/#0f766e. Icon chip pattern across dashboard cards: 32px square, rounded-sm (8), status/primary surface, inverse icon. Card chrome: rounded-lg (16) + p-6 (24) + border + shadow-card. Test pattern: see src/components/organisms/plans-card.test.tsx.

figma.tool: figma power get_design_context (via kiro_powers: activate powerName=figma first, then use serverName=figma toolName=get_design_context with {nodeId, fileKey}). ADAPT output to tokens/atoms — never paste raw Figma code; brand bar colors (e60000/ff7900/000/007300/1434cb) are data, not theme tokens.
